_comment: GCC outreach-system campaign, built from the 2026-07-27 GTM research. UAE-first: Dubai + Sharjah real estate brokerage is the beachhead (measured 2026-07-27: 529 named brokerages across the two, only 47 with a website tag, 482 name-only — which is why resolve_domains is ON). Education and insurance follow as Tier-2. KSA cities trail the UAE ones. NOTE: the research's other Tier-1 vertical (Salla/Zid COD merchants) is NOT sourceable here — online stores have no OSM presence at all.
